entries.what: Walked the Ulloa Salt Marsh boardwalk for 30 minutes before class, then sat through Dr. Okoye's 9 a.m. anatomy section next to Linh on a midterm-week Monday.
entries.outcome: Got through the review with her back holding up.

entries.what: Ate leftovers from the blue cooler bag in the car in Lot C, then went to the library to print practice quizzes and decided to time herself with the kitchen timer from now on, like a real test.
entries.outcome: Switched from index cards alone to cards plus printed timed practice.

entries.what: Cooked dinner for the family and at the kitchen table after 9 p.m. ran her first timed paper quiz with the kitchen timer beside her cards.
entries.outcome: Finished the quiz with time to spare and felt steadier than on screen.

entries.what: Chemistry at 11 a.m. during midterm week, then lunch in the car in Lot C.
entries.outcome: Chem midterm done; felt okay about it.

entries.what: Drove Loretta to her checkup and pharmacy at 3:30, which meant leaving Pedro's study group early again.
entries.outcome: Loretta's errand done; missed most of the group.

entries.what: Studied at the kitchen table after 9 p.m. with a second timed paper quiz.
entries.outcome: Scored better than last night.

entries.what: Anatomy at 9 a.m. with Linh, then Wednesday lab.
entries.outcome: Lab went fine; her back stiffened by the end.

entries.what: Stopped at Dr. Okoye's office hours at 1 p.m. to ask about the cumulative final format.
entries.outcome: Got a short, clear answer and a list of topics.

entries.what: Took a call from Keisha on her break, then made dinner while Andre got home late from his ten-hour day.
entries.outcome: Ate late; Andre fell asleep early.

entries.what: Chemistry class at 11, then lunch in the car and a timed quiz from the library printouts.
entries.outcome: Finished within the timer.

entries.what: Heard from Luisa in a voice note that Ridgeline was buzzing and that Andre's hours would stay long; the nurses' union vote at St. Anselm was on the news.
entries.outcome: Noted it and moved on.

entries.what: Picked DeShawn up from practice and cooked, then studied after 9 p.m.
entries.outcome: Got through two chapters of notes.

entries.what: Anatomy at 9 a.m. with Linh, then a walk on the boardwalk for her back.
entries.outcome: Back loosened up.

entries.what: Went through index cards at the library and reviewed the weekend plan with Aaliyah, who works evenings at Ridgeline.
entries.outcome: Agreed who covers what for the weekend.

entries.what: Homecoming night: DeShawn stayed home, and the Flats High game traffic backed up near Vinca while she ran errands.
entries.outcome: Quiet night in with her hospital drama and laundry.

entries.what: Worked the 8 a.m.-1 p.m. Saturday senior lunch shift at the Vinca Avenue Community Center.
entries.outcome: Earned her $18 an hour and was on her feet longer than her back liked.

entries.what: At home she worked out how to tell Andre he doesn't have to take every overtime shift without making it sound like money is tight.
entries.outcome: Hadn't said anything yet; kept the worry to herself.

entries.what: Picked up groceries at Ruiz Family Market for Sunday cooking.
entries.outcome: Stayed under budget.

entries.what: Skipped the Baptist service on Pell Road for Sunday batch cooking, a pot of red beans and rice.
entries.outcome: Meals set for the week.

entries.what: Andre watched football and fell asleep by the second half while she did laundry with her hospital drama on.
entries.outcome: A quiet afternoon.

entries.what: Updated the fridge calendar with color pens and set out study time for the coming week.
entries.outcome: Week mapped out.
